::: {.home-body}

## Personal Value Proposition

::: vp
As an HIV epidemiology researcher building skills in AI and machine learning, I help global health programs adopt AI tools that are grounded in population-based evidence such as PHIA data. I design and test these tools for the safety, privacy, and neutrality that sensitive health topics require, so that they support the people they serve rather than put them at risk.
:::

## About Me

I am an HIV epidemiology researcher. My work uses data from the Population-based HIV Impact Assessment (PHIA) surveys in Eswatini, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Uganda, and Zimbabwe to study HIV status non-disclosure: who does not share their HIV status, and why.

I am currently studying machine learning fundamentals in the AIML-500 course at Indiana Wesleyan University. My goal is to connect these two fields: to help HIV and global health programs use AI in ways that are evidence-based, respect privacy, and protect people in stigmatized situations.

## Artifacts

Each artifact is a finished piece of work from my AIML-500 coursework, with the process, tools, and value it offers to global health programs.

```{=html}
<ol class="artifact-index">
  <li>
    <span class="ai-num">1</span>
    <div class="ai-main">
      <h3><a href="hiv-disclosure-assistant.html">HIV Disclosure Support Assistant</a></h3>
      <p>A tested AI assistant that helps people think through HIV status disclosure safely and helps researchers summarize PHIA data, built with Design Thinking and verified sources only.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ai-meta"><span class="ai-type">Chatbot</span><span class="ai-skill">Building and testing a safe AI tool</span></div>
  </li>
  <li>
    <span class="ai-num">2</span>
    <div class="ai-main">
      <h3><a href="ml-vs-dl.html">Machine Learning vs. Deep Learning: Choosing the Right Approach</a></h3>
      <p>A case-study report comparing telecom churn prediction and Apple's Face ID to show how the type of data should decide between traditional machine learning and deep learning.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ai-meta"><span class="ai-type">Case study report</span><span class="ai-skill">Matching the method to the data</span></div>
  </li>
  <li>
    <span class="ai-num">3</span>
    <div class="ai-main">
      <h3><a href="nolla-health-ai.html">Can AI Help with Acne Care Without Losing Human Oversight?</a></h3>
```
